title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS/FMVSS 207, 210 (1 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT BUSES.  THE TETHER PLATES, WHICH ARE ATTACHED TO THE REAR OF BOTH THE UPPER AND LOWER FRAMES OF THE SUSPENSION UNIT, CONTAIN A SHARP EDGE WHICH CAN CAUSE PREMATURE WEAT OF THE NYLON TETHERS.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS," AND NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/SEAT REINFORCEMENT/FUEL HOSE (829 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH 30-INCH AND 34-INCH SEATS AND BARRIERS OR 36, 39, AND 45-INCH SEATS AND BARRIERS WITH OFFSET LEGS INSTALLED IN THE FIRST BODY SECTION BEHIND THE DRIVER.   WHEN NARROW SEATS AND BARRIERS (30" AND 34") OR SEATS AND BARRIERS WITH OFFSET LEGS ARE INSTALLED, ADDITIONAL FLOOR REINFORCEMENT IS ADDED.  IT WAS DISCOVERED THIS REINFORCEMENT INTERFERES WITH AND CHAFES THE RUBBER FUEL FILLER HOSE.

title: UD Trucks Corporation: NISSAN DIESEL/BRAKE SYSTEM (34 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS.   A SMALL SEAL BOOT IN THE SELF-ADJUSTING BRAKE SYSTEM LOCATED ON THE RIGHT REAR SLACK ADJUSTER MAY HAVE BEEN TORN IN THE MOVEMENT OF THE VEHICLE DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: VW/B-PILLAR MAT/FIRE (36,258 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE SOUND ABSORBING MAT ATTACHED TO THE INSIDE OF THE B-PILLAR SIDE TRIM PANEL COULD HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY INSTALLED.  SURFACE AND EDGES OF THE MAT COULD HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS.  IT COULD IGNITE WHEN EXPOSED TO THE EXHAUST GAS OF THE SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER IGNITER IN THE EVENT OF A SEVERE FRONT OR SIDE COLLISION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/AIR BAG (250,845 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  VAN AND WAGON MODEL PASSENGER VEHICLES.  IF WATER/ROAD SALT GETS ON THE INTERIOR FLOOR OF THE VEHICLE IN THE PROXIMITY OF THE AIR BAG ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (AECM), THE AECM CAN CORRODE.  THE RESULTING CORROSION CAN CAUSE THE DRIVER SIDE AIR BAG TO DEPLOY INADVERTENTLY.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/HEADLAMP SWITCH (79,366 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MODEL 3500 LIGHT DUTY TRUCKS ONLY.  OPERATION OF THE HEADLAMPS OVER AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME CAN RESULT IN HEADLAMP SWITCH FAILURE, CAUSING THE HEADLAMPS OR PARK LAMPS TO GO OUT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKE SWITCH (988,587 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PICKUP TRUCKS, CREW CABS, UTILITY TRUCKS AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.  THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH THE POLARITY OF THE WIRING FOR THE ZERO ADJUST BRAKE SWITCH REVERSED FROM WHAT WAS SPECIFIED ON THE SWITCH DRAWING.  WITH THE REVERSED POLARITY, THE CONTACTS IN THE BRAKE SWITCH CAN WEAR OUT PREMATURELY.  THE BRAKE SWITCH WILL PERFORM NORMALLY UNTIL THE BRAKE SWITCH CONTACTS WEAR OUT, RESULTING IN LOSS OF THE BRAKE LAMPS WITHOUT ANY WARNING TO THE DRIVER.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/THROTTLE RETURN SPRING (1,770 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.  THE HOOK ON THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS CAN FRACTURE AT LOW MILEAGE.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: SUZUKI/STEERING COLUMN SHAFT COUPLER (38 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.   THE COUPLING THAT CONNECTS THE STEERING COLUMN SHAFT TO THE INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT IS CRACKED.  THIS COULD ALLOW THE STEERING SHAFTS TO SEPARATE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL PUMP/WIRING HARNESS (23,097 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI VANS.  HEAT GENERATION IN THE WIRING HARNESS TO THE FUEL PUMP/SENDER ASSEMBLY CAN CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.  THE VEHICLE COULD EXPERIENCE A LOSS OF POWER AND BECOME IMMOBILIZED AND THE FUEL GAUGE MAY BE ERRATIC.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/IGNITION SWITCH ELECTRICAL SHORT (762,201 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI VANS.  THESE VEHICLES WERE PRODUCED WITH A HIGHER THAN SPECIFIED ELECTRICAL LOAD THROUGH THE ACCESSORY POWER FEED CIRCUIT.  THE POTENTIAL FOR CONTACT BETWEEN THE B2 (BATTERY), A2 (ACCESSORY), AND P1 (PROOF) CIRCUITS CAN OCCUR, CREATING A SHORT CIRCUIT, ALLOWING CURRENT TO FLOW THROUGH THE GROUND WIRE.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/BATTERY CABLE (2,261 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES MOUNTED ON CHASSIS EQUIPPED WITH AN OPTION FOR THREE BATTERIES.   THE BATTERY CABLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ROUTED PROPERLY ALLOWING THE CABLE TO BE CHAFED OR PINCHED.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES-BENZ/FRONT SEAT BELT SHOULDER ANCHOR (2,600 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   A DEFECTIVE WELD WAS DISCOVERED ON THE WELD NUT FOR THE BOLT USED TO SECURE THE FRONT SHOULDER SEAT BELT GUIDES.

title: Foretravel, Inc.: FORE TRAVEL/TAG AXLE ABS (26 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH TAG AXLES.  THERE IS REDUCED BRAKING ABILITY ON THE REAR AXLE DUE TO THE TAG AXLE ABS SENSORS READING "NO TIRE/WHEEL ROTATION," UNDER HEAVY BRAKING CONDITIONS.  THE SENSORS DETECT THAT THE WHEEL ROTATION HAS CEASED AND THEN STOPS SENDING A SIGNAL TO THE ABS COMPUTER.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/TIE ROD ASSEMBLY (40,091 affected)
summary: SCHOOL, TRANSIT, OR HEAVY DUTY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH SPICER 6,000 OR 8,000 LB. FRONT STEER AXLES.  THE TIE ROD END CAN PULL OUTBOARD AND SEPARATE FROM THE TIE ROD TUBE DUE TO IMPROPER THREAD ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN THE MALE TIE ROD END AND THE FEMALE TUBE.

title: redundant POLARIS INDUSTRIES, INC.: POLARIS/VICTORY/FUEL HOSE (715 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THE FUEL HOSE CAN FAIL RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK NEAR THE REAR CYLINDER OF THE MOTORCYCLE AND UNDER THE RIDER SEAT.

title: DANA CORPORATION: DANA/SPICER-TIE ROD ASSEMBLIES (864 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  SPICER 6,000 OR 8,000 LB. RATED CAPACITY FRONT STEER AXLES.  THE TIE ROD END CAN PULL OUTBOARD AND SEPARATE FROM THE TIE ROD TUBE DUE TO IMPROPER THREAD ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN THE MALE TIE ROD END AND THE FEMALE TUBE.

title: DANA CORPORATION: DANA/SPICER/BEARING CONES (90 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  FRONT STEERING AXLE ASSEMBLIES, 160BN200 3, 160BN200 5, 160BN200 7, 160BN200 8, 161BN204 2, AND 161BN205 2.  THE INNER WHEEL BEARING CONE FOR THE STEERING AXLE WHEEL HUB ASSEMBLY DOES NOT PROPERLY FIT ONTO THE OEM STEERING AXLE SPINDLE ASSEMBLY.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/STEERING ARM MAINTENANCE (19,600 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT COACHES.  THE STEERING ARMS ON THESE VEHICLES ARE NOT BEING PROPERLY MAINTAINED AT RECOMMENDED INSPECTION AND MAINTENANCE INTERVALS.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY-DAVIDSON/BRACE SUPPORT (1,831 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  PART NOS. 66693-98 AND 66680-98 ARE USED ON 1984-1999 FXR MOTORCYCLES (EQUIPPED WITH MID-VEHICLE REAR BRAKE CONTROLS AND 1991-1998 FXD MOTORCYCLES (EQUIPPED WITH MID-VEHICLE REAR BRAKE CONTROLS).  ON THESE MOTORCYCLES, THE REAR BRAKE PEDAL CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE BRACE SUPPORTS. ON THESE MOTORCYCLES, THE INSTRUCTION SHEET FOR THESE SUPPORTS LACKS INFORMATION REGARDING THE PROPER ROUTING OF THE REAR BRAKE RESERVOIR HOSE.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: COOPER/INADEQUATE RUBBER (216 affected)
summary: TIRE DESCRIPTION:  COOPER COBRA RADIAL G/T P215/70R14, SERIAL NUMBERS 3DHYC28468 (NOVEMBER 15-21, 1998), 3DHYC28478 (NOVEMBER 22-28, 1998), AND 3DHYC28488 (NOVEMBER 29-DECEMBER 5, 1998); AND VIPER RADIAL GT (SERIAL NUMBERS 3DHYUDN468 (NOVEMBER 15-NOVEMBER 21, 1998) AND 3DHYUDN478 (NOVEMBER 22-28, 1998), TUBELESS RADIAL STANDARD LOAD TIRES. summary: TIRE DESCRIPTION:  COOPER SUPER ROAD SERVICE, 7.00-15 LT/8PR TUBELESS BIAS, LOAD RANGE D, TIRES (SERIAL NUMBERS UPNVBCH019, UPNVBCH029, AND UPNVBCH039, JANUARY 3 - JANUARY 23, 1999).  THESE TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 119, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS," DUE TO A LOAD AND INFLATION PLATE MISMATCH.

summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET MASTER CYLINDERS USED ON USED ON CERTAIN 1988 THROUGH 1994 CHEVROLET AND GMC LIGHT DUTY TRUCKS; 1990 THROUGH 1995 ASTRO AND SAFARI MINI VANS; 1993-1994 CAPRICE AND 1994 IMPALA MODEL VEHICLES; AND 1994 THROUGH 1997 DODGE RAM LIGHT DUTY TRUCKS.
